meta.description: Source-linked calculators and visual tools for sustainability reports, annual reports and carbon pricing.

shell.disclaimer: Isoline is a compliance-readiness tool; it does not replace legal advice, independent assurance or accredited verification. Every value shows its source and date; final decisions require expert approval.

actions.resetHint: Restores this tool's values for the sample client

dates.cbam_first_declaration: First annual declaration and surrender for 2026 imports
dates.cbam_repurchase: Deadline to request repurchase of excess certificates
dates.ets_monitoring_plan: Monitoring methodology plan for pilot installations (≈, extendable by up to 6 months)
dates.ets_price_start: Price mechanism starts in the pilot
dates.ets_surrender_2027: Surrender for 2027 emissions (last working day of November)
dates.ets_permit: End of the 3-year window for emission permits
dates.ets_surrender: Allowance surrender (last working day of November)

overview.result: {n} obligations affect this client directly or through the value chain; total inventory {total} tCO₂e, 2030 CBAM exposure {cbam}.

journey.noTool: This stage runs outside the platform (audit, board, KAP).
journey.noData: No measurable data for this stage; set the status by hand.

scope.title: Scope and frameworks
scope.what: Decide which frameworks the company reports against under TSRS, CSRD, GRI and customer requests, and which transition reliefs it uses.
scope.tasks: Run the applicability check|Choose the framework mix (TSRS + GRI etc.)|Record the transition reliefs|Define the reporting boundary (consolidation)
scope.outputs: Scope decision, framework list, boundary note

materiality.title: Double materiality
materiality.what: Score topics on impact and financial materiality, set the threshold and approve the topics in scope.
materiality.tasks: Collect stakeholder input|Score topics on impact and finance|Justify the threshold|Obtain management approval
materiality.outputs: Materiality matrix, topic list, rationale log

data.title: Data collection
data.what: Collect energy, emissions, water, waste, safety and HR data with evidence from each unit.
data.tasks: Assign data owners|Collect invoices, meter and HR records|Check units and periods|Flag estimated data

calculate.title: Calculation
calculate.what: Calculate scope 1-2-3, intensities, taxonomy shares and indicators; record methods and factor sources.
calculate.tasks: Select and cite emission factors|Calculate location- and market-based scope 2|Prioritise scope 3 categories|Run a year-on-year variance check

targets.title: Targets and transition plan
targets.what: Prepare the science-based pathway, abatement measures, carbon-price effects and the transition plan disclosure.
targets.tasks: Fix base and target years|Place measures on the cost curve|Add CBAM and ETS cost effects|Write the transition plan narrative
targets.outputs: Pathway chart, MACC, financial effects table

write.title: Drafting and mapping
write.what: Fill the template sections and prepare the framework crosswalk and content index.
write.tasks: Export the template to Word|Assign section owners|Build the GRI / TSRS content index|Check bilingual consistency

assurance.title: Assurance
assurance.what: A KGK-authorised firm performs limited assurance; prepare the evidence file and management representations.
assurance.tasks: Organise the evidence folder|Answer assurer queries|Process corrections|Receive the assurance report

publish.title: Design and publication
publish.what: Hand approved content to the design agency; publish on KAP and the website.
publish.tasks: Deliver chart datasets|Final read and sign-off|KAP filing (TSRS-compliant report)|Web publication

plan.title: Calendar and owners
plan.what: Choose the content profile (TTK, CMB, BRSA), assign section owners and set the timeline.
plan.tasks: Choose the report profile|Assign section owners|Plan backwards from AGM and KAP dates

financials.title: Financial statements and audit
financials.what: Bring audited financial statements and key ratios into the annual report.
financials.tasks: Receive audited statements|Calculate sales, profitability and debt/equity ratios|Reconcile figures with the report

content.title: Content drafting
content.what: Draft text for every item of the minimum-content regulation and tick it off in the checklist.
content.tasks: Fill the checklist|Write investments, risks and internal control sections|Compile donations and lawsuits

governance.title: Corporate governance forms
governance.what: Listed companies prepare the URF and KYBF forms and the sustainability principles compliance framework.
governance.tasks: Update URF and KYBF|Complete the sustainability principles table|Flag changes from last year

sustainability_summary.title: Sustainability summary
sustainability_summary.what: Carry emissions, energy, safety and workforce indicators into the report's summary page.
sustainability_summary.tasks: Pull summary indicators from the tools|Check consistency with the TSRS report

board.title: Board approval
board.what: The board approves and signs the report; dissenting opinions are added with reasons.

kap.title: KAP and general assembly
kap.what: Publish the report with the financial report on KAP, at least three weeks before the general assembly.
kap.tasks: KAP filing|Web publication|Include in AGM documents

goods.title: Goods and CN mapping
goods.what: Map exported goods to CN codes, sectors and production routes; identify EU buyers.
goods.tasks: Confirm CN codes|Define production routes|Ask EU buyers about authorised declarant status

monitoring.title: Installation monitoring
monitoring.what: Monitor fuel, material and electricity flows; reuse the Turkish ETS monitoring data line.
monitoring.tasks: Prepare the monitoring plan|Connect meter and lab data|Record precursors

embedded.title: Embedded emissions
embedded.what: Calculate specific embedded emissions per good from direct, indirect and precursor emissions.
embedded.tasks: Calculate attributed emissions|Add precursor SEE values|Compare with default values

verify.title: Accredited verification
verify.what: An EU-accredited verifier verifies the emissions report with a site visit in the first year.
verify.tasks: Select a verifier|Prepare the evidence file|Schedule the site visit

pack.title: Data pack for the EU buyer
pack.what: Send the operator emissions report and evidence to the EU importer.
pack.tasks: Complete the operator data pack|Attach proof of carbon price paid|Send the pack to the buyer

cost.title: Cost and pricing
cost.what: Project CBAM cost to 2034 and reflect it in prices and contracts.
cost.tasks: Set price scenarios|Quantify verified vs default data|Update contract clauses

declare.title: Annual declaration
declare.what: The authorised declarant in the EU files the annual declaration and surrenders certificates.
declare.tasks: Answer the buyer's questions|Track post-declaration corrections

cbam.result: By 2030 the CBAM obligation passed to your EU buyers reaches {cost}; 2026–2034 total {total}.
cbam.empty: Add products to see the cost projection for CBAM goods you export to the EU.
cbam.startPriceHint: Official 2026 quarterly prices: Q1 €{q1}, Q2 €{q2}, Q3 €{q3}. The sample uses the three-quarter average.
cbam.originPrice: Carbon price actually paid in Türkiye
cbam.originPriceHint: Effective price after free allocation. Usually 0 in 2026–2027 because the Turkish ETS pilot allocates 100 % free.

cnStatus.partialDetail: Only part of this code is in Annex I. Enter the full 8-digit CN code or check it against Annex I.
cnStatus.notCoveredDetail: This CN code is not listed in Annex I of Reg. 2023/956.
cnStatus.invalidDetail: Enter a CN code with at least 4 digits (e.g. 7208 51 20).
cnStatus.sectorMismatch: Annex I lists this code under {sector}; check the selected sector.

cbam.useDefaultHint: Without verified installation data, the EU default value plus the year's mark-up applies.
cbam.noIndirect: Indirect emissions do not count for this good.
cbam.figSavingNote: Extra cost if every product used default values
cbam.chartCostCaption: Bars show the selected method; lines show cost if all products used verified data or default values.
cbam.chartEmissionsCaption: As the free-allocation adjustment shrinks, the share subject to certificates grows; the CBAM factor falls from 97.5 % in 2026 to zero in 2034.
cbam.cscfAssumed: The CSCF for 2031–2033 is not yet determined; the free-allocation adjustment assumes 1.

notes.deMinimis: Imports by an EU importer whose net mass does not exceed 50 tonnes in total in a calendar year are exempt (Art. 2a, Annex VII; exactly 50 tonnes is still exempt); once exceeded, all of that year's imports are in scope. There is no threshold for electricity and hydrogen.
notes.indirect: Indirect (electricity) emissions count for cement, fertilisers and agglomerated iron ore (CN 2601 12 00); other iron and steel, aluminium, hydrogen and electricity use direct emissions only (Reg. 2023/956 Annex II).
notes.markup: Default values carry a mark-up: 10 % in 2026, 20 % in 2027, 30 % from 2028; 1 % for fertilisers.
notes.deduction: The carbon price paid in the country of origin can be deducted only for actual (verified) emissions (Art. 9(1)); with default values only the Commission's yearly default carbon prices can be used and none are published yet, so default-value lines get no deduction. The implementing rules are still a draft as of 17.10.2026 (Ares(2026)4841230); this line is an estimate.
notes.holding: From 2027, at each quarter end, certificates covering at least 50 % of year-to-date embedded emissions must be held.
notes.penalty: The standard penalty is €100 per certificate not surrendered.
notes.csCf: Free allocation adjustment = mass × CBAM factor × CSCF × benchmark (Implementing Regulation 2025/2620). The CSCF is 100 % for each year 2026–2030 (Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/1862); 2031–2033 are not yet determined and use 1. Take the benchmark and route mapping from the 2025/2620 annex.

cbam.sampleWarning: Benchmarks and default values for the sample client are illustrative, not official. For a real calculation enter the values for your CN code and route from Implementing Regulations 2025/2620 and 2025/2621.
cbam.operatorExportHint: Send your EU importer a per-product embedded-emissions summary. This file is not the Commission's official communication template; use it with the verifier's report.

ghg.result: Total inventory {total} tCO₂e, of which {s12} tCO₂e is scope 1 and 2. Share of estimated data {est}.
ghg.label: Description
ghg.certifiedHint: Counts at zero emissions in the market-based method.
ghg.supplierFactorHint: For the market-based figure. Left empty, the location-based grid factor applies to the uncovered part.
ghg.intensityNote: tCO₂e/t · revenue intensity {rev} tCO₂e per TRY m
ghg.chartWaterfallCaption: From scope 1 items to the total inventory; dashed outlines mark items dominated by estimated data.

notes.factors: Default NCV and CO₂ factors are IPCC 2006 Tier 1 values and exclude CH₄ and N₂O. Replace them with supplier, BOTAŞ or national inventory values.
notes.grid: Location-based scope 2 uses the ETKB 2023 consumption-point factors: transmission 0.436, distribution 0.469 tCO₂e/MWh. Sites outside the Turkish grid can carry their own grid factor (e.g. an EEA country value).
notes.market: No residual-mix factor is published for Türkiye; uncovered electricity uses the grid factor and the report should say so.
notes.scope3: Scope 3 factors are entered by the user and each line records its source.
notes.gwp: Refrigerants use IPCC AR6 GWP100 (Table 7.SM.7, e.g. SF₆ 24,300, R-134a 1,530); state the GWP set in the report.
notes.tsrs: Under TSRS 2, scope 3 is not required in the first two reporting years; TSRS 2 GHG amendments apply from 2027.

import.title: Bulk data (CSV)
import.hint: Fill fuel, process, refrigerant, electricity and scope 3 rows in Excel and upload them as CSV. Use a comma or a point for decimals.

err.missingColumns: Required columns missing: {cols}. Download the template and use its header row.
err.badConnection: connection must be transmission or distribution ({value}).
err.badFactor: emission factor could not be read ({value}).
err.badType: unknown row type ({value}); use fuel, process, refrigerant, electricity or scope3.

ghg.gridFactorHint: For sites outside the Turkish grid. Left empty, the ETKB 2023 factor for the connection point ({value}) applies.

ets.result: Category {cat} installation: a {deficit} tCO₂e allowance shortfall and {cost} cost expected in {year}.
ets.resultA: Category A installation: outside the ETS, with monitoring, reporting and verification duties only.
ets.sectorHint: Pilot: electricity, cement, iron and steel, aluminium and fertilisers.
ets.emissionsHint: The category follows conservatively estimated annual emissions at installed capacity, excluding biomass CO₂.
ets.benchmarkHint: In the pilot, non-power benchmarks are the weighted average of all installations; enter the published value.
ets.priceHint: No market price exists yet; enter a scenario value.
ets.figFineNote: Verified report not filed on time, 2026 amount; 80 % discount in the pilot
ets.chartCaption: Emissions covered by free allocation and the shortfall to buy; 2026 is reporting-only.

notes.formula: Free allocation = benchmark × free allocation rate × sector activity coefficient × activity level, rounded up (Regulation art. 13/7).
notes.pilot: The pilot covers 2026 and 2027 emissions; 2026 is reporting-only, pricing starts in 2027 and allocation is 100 % free (KPK/2026/1).
notes.penalty: Each allowance not surrendered costs twice the higher of the last three months' primary and secondary market averages; the shortfall must still be surrendered next year.
notes.pilotDiscount: Administrative fines under the Climate Law are discounted by 80 % in the pilot.
notes.cbamLink: EU CBAM allows deducting the carbon price actually paid at origin; with free allocation in the pilot this stays limited in 2026–2027.

ets.sampleWarning: The benchmark, allocation rates and price are a sample scenario. Update them when the published benchmarks and National Allocation Plan are available.

pathway.resultGap: In {year}, planned measures leave you {gap} tCO₂e above the 1.5 °C path.
pathway.resultOk: In {year}, planned measures stay {margin} tCO₂e below the 1.5 °C path.
pathway.empty: Enter base-year emissions to see the science-based pathway.
pathway.scope2ShareHint: Base-year scope 2 emissions as a share of scope 1+2. Scope 2 reaches net zero by 2040, so a higher share raises the minimum rate. Leave empty to treat it all as scope 1.
pathway.targetYearHint: SBTi near-term targets cover 5–10 years from submission.
pathway.chartCaption: The dark band is the 1.5 °C-aligned zone, the light band the well-below 2 °C zone; the line tracks expected emissions with planned measures.
pathway.maccCaption: Bar width is annual abatement, height is cost per tonne; the dashed line is the reference carbon price.
pathway.rateLine: Linear reduction rates used in the chart (base year {year}): {r15} a year for scope 1+2 (1.5 °C) and {rwb} a year for scope 3 (well-below 2 °C). The SBTi minimums are {min15} and {minwb}; the rate rises with a later base year and a higher scope 2 share.

notes.rates: Near-term targets use SBTi linear absolute contraction. The minimum rates are 4.2 % a year for scope 1+2 and 2.5 % for scope 3; under the Net-Zero Standard V1.3.1 Method Appendix (14.04.2026) the rate rises dynamically with the base year (e.g. scope 3, base year 2024: 2.88 %). If the scope 2 share field is left empty, scope 1+2 is treated as all scope 1, which gives the lowest rate; entering the share gives the real minimum.
notes.netzero: The long-term net-zero path assumes at least 90 % absolute reduction from the base year by 2050, with residuals neutralised.
notes.v2: SBTi Net-Zero Standard V2.0 takes effect on 31.01.2027; its final methods arrive in Q4 2026, so V2 parameters are not modelled yet.
notes.ndc: Türkiye's NDC 3.0 targets at most 643 MtCO₂e in 2035 and net zero by 2053; mind the scale difference when comparing.
notes.macc: Negative-cost measures save money; measures below the reference price are economic against CBAM and ETS costs.

env.result: Annual energy use {toe} toe; renewable share {ren}, waste recovery rate {rec}.
env.energyFoot: Energy intensity: {ints} GJ per TRY m
env.waterFoot: Water intensity: {ints} m³ per TRY m
env.energyManager: Above 1,000 toe a year: an energy manager and annual notification are required

notes.water: Water consumption = withdrawal − discharge. Use a source such as WRI Aqueduct for water stress and cite it.
notes.waste: Recovery rate is waste diverted to recovery over total waste; disposal methods are disclosed under GRI 306-4/5.
notes.refs: GRI 302 and 305 are replaced by GRI 103 and GRI 102 from 2027; numbers shown are for 2026 reports.

work.result: LTIFR {ltifr}, unadjusted gender pay gap {gap}, {train} training hours per employee.
work.chartCaption: Share of women and men across all employees and in management.

notes.bases: GRI 403-9 allows rates per 200,000 or 1,000,000 hours; state the base used.
notes.payGap: Unadjusted pay gap = (men's average − women's average) / men's average.
notes.headcount: Turnover and training rates use the average of opening and closing headcount.

tax.alignedHint: Technical screening criteria, do-no-significant-harm and minimum safeguards are all met.
tax.notAssessedHint: Eligible activities below 10 % of a KPI combined may be left unassessed.
tax.capNote: The not-assessed share must stay below 10 % for each KPI
tax.chartCaption: Aligned, eligible-not-aligned, not-assessed and not-eligible shares for each KPI.

notes.threshold: Under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/73, non-financial companies may treat activities totalling under 10 % of turnover, capex or opex as non-material, KPI by KPI.
notes.steps: Alignment runs eligibility, then technical screening criteria, do-no-significant-harm and minimum safeguards.
notes.tr: The Türkiye Green Taxonomy Regulation (OG 24.09.2026) is voluntary for the real sector; lenders may ask for it.
notes.fi: Turkish taxonomy reporting for financial institutions is not mandatory before 2029.

mat.result: {n} of {total} topics are material; {double} are material on both impact and finance.
mat.thresholdHint: A topic is material when its impact or financial score is at or above this value.
mat.likelihoodHint: 5 = actual impact; likelihood does not discount severity.
mat.chartCaption: Financial materiality on the horizontal axis, impact on the vertical; filled points are material. Click a point to edit its scores.

notes.method: Impact score is the average of scale, scope and (for negative impacts) irremediability, weighted by likelihood for potential impacts. Financial score is magnitude × likelihood / 5.
notes.topdown: Revised ESRS (2026/1563) allow a top-down assessment based on reasonable and supportable information.
notes.evidence: Record the rationale, stakeholder input and evidence for each score; the tool structures scoring, management decides.
notes.tsrs: TSRS materiality is investor-focused financial materiality; double materiality is needed for ESRS and GRI.

tsrs.bank_always: BRSA-regulated banks are in TSRS scope regardless of size.
tsrs.tmsf: Banks under the SDIF are out of scope.
tsrs.watchlist: Watchlist and qualified-investor venture capital market companies are outside mandatory scope; TSRS may be applied voluntarily.
tsrs.not_listed_type: This entity type is not on KGK's mandatory list; TSRS may be applied voluntarily.
tsrs.status_two_years: Entering scope requires the regulated status in at least two periods.
tsrs.small_fi_relief: Unlisted banks and financial institutions with no more than one branch or 250 employees at the previous year end are outside mandatory scope during the scope 3 relief (first two reporting years); they may report voluntarily.
tsrs.below_thresholds: Two of three criteria were not exceeded in two consecutive periods; TSRS may be applied voluntarily.
tsrs.threshold_transition_review: The KGK decision (Official Gazette 16.01.2026, 33139) applies the new thresholds (1 bn / 2 bn / 500) to accounting periods starting on or after 1 January 2025; no official text explains how they apply to the 2023–2024 reference years. Cross-check with KGK's SÜHA tool.
tsrs.relief_comparatives: Comparative information is not required in the first reporting period.
tsrs.relief_climate_first: The first year may cover climate-related risks and opportunities only (climate first).
tsrs.relief_timing: First-year reports may be published with the interim report or within 9 months of period end.
tsrs.relief_scope3: Scope 3 is not required in the first two reporting years.
tsrs.relief_2024_extension: For 2024 first-time reporters, E4, E5 and E6(b) reliefs also apply to the 2025 report.
tsrs.s2_amendments_2027: TSRS 2 GHG amendments apply from 1.1.2027 (scope 3 category 15 and financed emissions).
tsrs.assurance: The report requires limited assurance by a KGK-authorised firm.

csrd.eu_large: More than 1,000 employees and over €450 m turnover in the EU: reporting under ESRS 2026 from FY2027.
csrd.non_eu_parent: Non-EU parent: EU turnover above €450 m and an EU subsidiary or branch above €200 m; from FY2028.
csrd.value_chain_protected: With 1,000 or fewer employees the value-chain cap protects you; EU customers cannot require more than the voluntary standard's short list.
csrd.value_chain_supplier: CSRD-scope EU customers will request value-chain data; the cap does not protect companies above 1,000 employees.
csrd.out_of_scope: Below CSRD thresholds and no EU customer link.

csddd.in_scope: Groups above 5,000 employees and €1.5 bn turnover face due diligence duties from 26.07.2029.
csddd.supplier: In-scope EU customers may request human rights and environmental due diligence information.

cbam.no_sector: No CBAM goods exported to the EU.
cbam.operator_data: Your EU importer needs verified embedded emissions per installation and good for its declaration.
cbam.de_minimis_check: Imports up to 50 tonnes a year in total per EU importer may be exempt; check the total per buyer.
cbam.default_markup: Without verified data, default values apply with a 10 % mark-up in 2026 rising to 30 % from 2028.
cbam.downstream_2028: An extension to downstream goods such as screws, wire and tubes is under negotiation for 2028.

ets.category_a: Category A (up to 50 kt CO₂e): outside the ETS, monitoring, reporting and verification only.
ets.category_b: Category B (50–500 kt CO₂e): in the ETS.
ets.category_c: Category C (above 500 kt CO₂e): in the ETS.
ets.pilot: The pilot covers 2026–2027 emissions; 2026 is reporting-only.
ets.pilot_free: Allocation is 100 % free and benchmark-based in the pilot.
ets.non_pilot_sector: The main activity is not a pilot sector; follow the Directorate's decisions for inclusion timing.

ar.ttk: All capital companies prepare an annual activity report under the TCC and the minimum-content regulation.
ar.spk: Listed companies publish the annual report on KAP within 60 days (70 days consolidated) under CMB II-14.1.
ar.cg_forms: The corporate governance compliance report (URF) and information form (KYBF) are published on KAP.
ar.spk_sust_template: Star, Main and Sub Market companies report against the CMB sustainability principles framework.
ar.bddk: Banks also follow the BRSA annual report regulation.
ar.public_body: Public administrations follow separate annual report rules; not verified in this release.
ar.eu_art19: In the EU the management report follows Accounting Directive art. 19 and 20.

tax.tr_fi: Turkish taxonomy reporting for financial institutions does not start before 2029.
tax.tr_real_sector: The Turkish taxonomy is voluntary for the real sector; green finance applications may ask for it.

eudr.dds: Placing on the EU market requires a due diligence statement (DDS) and plot geolocation data.

dpp.pending_acts: Product-group delegated acts are pending; iron and steel targeted for end-2026.

energy.manager: Industrial companies using 1,000 toe or more a year appoint an energy manager and file annually.

app.sharesListedHint: Unlisted financial institutions with no more than one branch or 250 employees are outside mandatory scope during the scope 3 relief.
app.euTurnoverPrev: Net turnover in the EU (previous year)
app.euTurnoverPrevHint: The non-EU parent rule requires EU turnover above €450 m in each of the last two years.

claims.textHint: The text never leaves the browser; it is screened on this page only.

claims.sample: Sample text — At Anadolu Yassı Çelik we work with an eco-friendly production approach. Our new coil range is carbon neutral; we offset our remaining emissions through forestry projects. We will be a net zero company by 2030. Our packaging is 100% recyclable and we raised the renewable electricity share at our sites to 20%.

offset.title: Offset-based neutrality
offset.why: Claiming that a product has a neutral, reduced or positive climate impact on the basis of offsetting emissions is banned in all circumstances.
offset.fix: Drop the neutrality claim; report the measured reduction within the product's own life cycle and any offset contribution separately, with figures.

future.title: Future target without a plan
future.why: Future environmental performance claims (e.g. 'net zero by 2030') are misleading without clear, verifiable commitments and a public implementation plan monitored by an independent expert.
future.fix: Back the target with milestones, scope (S1-2-3), allocated resources and independent verification; cite the plan in the Decarbonisation pathway tool.

absolute.title: Absolute wording
absolute.why: Absolute wording such as '100%', 'completely' or 'zero impact' misleads unless proven for the whole product and life cycle; a claim about part of a product must say so.
absolute.fix: Make the claim measurable and bounded (which component, what share, against which standard) and state the evidence.
absolute.ref: Directive (EU) 2024/825 — UCPD Annex I point 4b; Art. 6(2)

generic.title: Generic environmental claim
generic.why: Generic claims such as 'eco-friendly', 'green' or 'ecological' are banned unless recognised excellent environmental performance can be shown.
generic.fix: Replace the generic phrase with a specific claim saying what improved by how much (e.g. 'energy use per product down 12% on 2024') and cite the source.
